tool_args.rationale: All paid training rows use H=0.6, while both the ODE and basin-style fits failed fresh confirmation. A slow-horizon discriminating measurement is the most direct way to test whether the mismatch comes from unobserved horizon dependence before committing to another model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The nine rows all share H=0.6, and that specified four-parameter model was already refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.628116).
An open-branch probe has already been acquired; another is less informative than varying the only observed horizon.
The current rows already span varied states and inputs; collecting more at the same horizon leaves temporal mechanisms poorly distinguished.
Fresh confirmation refuted stationary models, but there is no evidence of high-frequency chaotic oscillation or that all stationary mechanisms are refuted.
